summary: Spec fidelity (ruling 2, recorded for the contract author): L2.async returns unsupported when no command document has the option --wait (safety.rs l2_async head), so a tool that declares async: true and takes no --wait skips the whole MUST row (accepted exit 0, async:true and an identifier, not-complete, next[0] a wait, the three outcomes), though checker.md makes the row 'M (when offered)' and offered is async: true; 13.3 makes --wait a SHOULD. Real canon L2 run: L2.async unsupported 'no command has the reserved option --wait' and there is no async command at all, so no effect on canon. Blast radius: tools that declare async and wait some other way. Closes when the contract says how a wait is recognised.
